promises.claim: The tour opens the studios and the library for your steps, and the session on the courses sets the first-year fall’s first pieces.
promises.holds: A studio or library step is refused until the tour is done (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:518, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:519); the session on the courses sets each first-year fall course's first piece through `setWork` (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1674).

promises.claim: Each rehearsal step rehearses the way you chose to play the scene.
promises.holds: `prepare` rehearses the chosen way in with any step of the rehearsal or partner part (`rehearseChoice`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:689; src/engine/systems/material.ts:220).

promises.claim: A step trains its skill for up to ${WORK.trainingSteps} steps a piece, and practices the ability it calls on.
promises.holds: A step's `trains` grows its skill while `a.trained < WORK.trainingSteps` (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:692), and every step that moves its part practices `PREP_ABILITY`'s ability (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:699).

promises.claim: In the class it’s due, the preparation is judged and the showing gives its band and its note.
promises.holds: The class day's reckoning asks `meetingWeight` for each course (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3489), which finds the piece due (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1473) and shows it (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1498): `show` judges it (`judgeWork`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:974), bands it and writes the note (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1096-1229).

promises.claim: The term’s review counts each piece’s band: once ${ESTIMATE.coursework.shown} or more are due, ${pct(ESTIMATE.coursework.unready)} Unready or not shown is short.
promises.holds: `termTally` counts each piece's band, a piece not shown as Unready (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1329); the review reads it (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3204-3205: counted at `ESTIMATE.coursework.shown`, short at `ESTIMATE.coursework.unready`).

promises.claim: Readiness sets how far each step moves its part, and your condition in class counts in the showing.
promises.holds: A step's move is scaled by the day's focus at the hour (`focusAt`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:668, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:683; src/engine/systems/school.ts:950); the showing is judged at the day's condition at the meeting (`conditionAt`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:974; src/engine/systems/school.ts:960).

promises.claim: Each showing is kept on your record, where Your Work So Far reads your strengths and what keeps holding you back.
promises.holds: `show` keeps the judged piece (`recordWork`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1134; src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:663), which counts it for life with its limits (`countWork`, src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:614); Your Work So Far reads the record's strengths and the limits kept for life (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:92-127).

promises.claim: Reading the scene to 30% with ${READ.label} opens the questions.
promises.holds: `tableWorkRefusal` refuses an answer under 30% read (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:597), asked by `school.choose` (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1970).

promises.claim: A partner may come to class with another answer to a question you’ve answered, and ask you to keep yours, take theirs or try both.
promises.holds: In class, a partner on a shared scene with a question answered may bring a different reading (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:357), answered Keep Yours, Try Theirs or Try Both (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:605-628).

promises.claim: The showing counts your answers as the table work, and an answer the text doesn’t support can be its note.
promises.holds: The showing's table work is the answers the text supports (`interpretationOf`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:753), and an answer it doesn't support is a note candidate (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:895).

promises.claim: An answer that differs from your partner’s leaves the scene together at ${pct(ENSEMBLE.apart)} agreement until you’ve tried both.
promises.holds: Kept apart, the scene together reads `ENSEMBLE.apart` agreement (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:798, src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:615), cleared when both are tried at a rehearsal kept (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1812-1815).

promises.claim: On ${SCENE_STUDY.title} and courses like it, Work It Through can name the table work as a problem, with no way to work on it there: an answer the text supports is what fixes it.
promises.holds: A part of the preparation short is a `prep` problem (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:125-130), and no adjustment answers a `prep` problem (src/engine/content/workbook.ts:38-43), so it has no way at it; an answer the text supports raises the table work, and the problem leaves.

promises.claim: A choice pays off once it’s rehearsed, and the rehearsal steps, ${ALONE.label} among them, are what rehearse it, with the rehearsals kept with your partner.
promises.holds: The showing reads the way's rehearsal as a part of its preparation against its mark (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1010, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1026); the steps on the rehearsal part rehearse it (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:689), and so does a rehearsal kept with the partner (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1799).

promises.claim: A rehearsal kept with your partner rehearses the choice too, as a rehearsal step does.
promises.holds: `rehearsalOutcome` rehearses the chosen way in at a rehearsal kept (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1799).

promises.claim: The showing counts the choice: what it favors, the abilities it uses, and how far it’s rehearsed.
promises.holds: `workContext` reads the scene's material with the way played (`materialContext`: its lean, its abilities, its fit, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1023-1027) and its rehearsal as preparation (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1010).

promises.claim: An aspect left open here can be played its own way in one part of the scene, with Play This Part Another Way.
promises.holds: Play This Part Another Way is offered only on an axis the whole leaves open (`waysFor`, src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:162-169), for a segment (`optionsOf`, src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:198-205).

promises.claim: Every way you choose and show is kept, and Your Work So Far names one you choose most of the time.
promises.holds: A side newly chosen is noted (`school.choose_playing`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1958) and a showing notes the sides shown (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1136); Your Work So Far names a side chosen most of the time (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:149-160).

promises.claim: A note that’s open and given ${LEARNING.persistent} times, on a part a piece prepares, opens another way to work on it on that piece.
promises.holds: `persistentFor` offers a way only for an open note given `LEARNING.persistent` times on a part the piece prepares (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:527-534), asked by `approachRefusal` (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:537).

promises.claim: A piece the course revises comes back open, due at its next class, with the note to take.
promises.holds: A revised template's piece is set revising, due at the next meeting, with the note (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1507-1512), shown again there (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1540-1563).

promises.claim: The band sets how much the class grows the course’s skills, from ${pct(WORK.weight.unready)} of a usual class for Unready to ${pct(WORK.weight.exceptional)} for Exceptional.
promises.holds: `meetingWeight` returns `WORK.weight[band]` (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1538), the weight the class day grows the course's skills by (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3516).

promises.claim: The term’s review counts the bands: once ${ESTIMATE.coursework.shown} or more pieces are due, ${pct(ESTIMATE.coursework.unready)} or more Unready or not shown is short.
promises.holds: `termTally` counts the bands (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1329); the review reads it (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3204-3205).

promises.claim: Under a paired piece, the scene together shows your partner’s preparation, timing, answers and any slip, separately from your band.
promises.holds: The scene together is worked out apart from the band (`togetherOf`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:980; `sharedOf`, src/engine/systems/ensemble.ts:82) and kept as `showing.together` (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1142), its partner's preparation, timing, agreement and slip in its parts.

promises.claim: Each showing is on your record, and a note still open after ${LEARNING.persistent} times shows in Your Work So Far as one that keeps coming back.
promises.holds: The record keeps each showing (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1134); an open note given `LEARNING.persistent` times or more is A Note That Keeps Coming Back (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:123-127).

promises.claim: It opens once a note has been given ${LEARNING.persistent} times on the same part and is still open.
promises.holds: `persistentFor`: open, and given `LEARNING.persistent` times (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:530).

promises.claim: ${APPROACHES.drill.label} adds a step to the piece, and ${APPROACHES.objective.label} changes what counts most in it.
promises.holds: A drill adds a step (`activitiesOf`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:587-589); Put It First weighs the dimensions reading the part more (`workContext`'s `putFirst`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1015-1021).

promises.claim: ${APPROACHES.partner.label} works on the part at the next rehearsal kept with your partner.
promises.holds: `rehearsalOutcome` works the part once at the next rehearsal kept (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1805).

promises.claim: ${APPROACHES.smaller.label} caps the band at Working, and the term’s review counts a Working piece as neither Unready nor Strong.
promises.holds: `bandFor` caps a smaller piece at Working (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1090-1093); `termTally` counts Working as neither Unready nor Strong (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1334-1335).

promises.claim: You can’t ask a partner you haven’t met; Meeting Your Class, or your first class, meets them.
promises.holds: `askRefusal` refuses a partner not met (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1707); Meeting Your Class meets them (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1665-1667), and so does the first class (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3522).

promises.claim: A rehearsal you agree goes on your calendar, and the clock stops at it.
promises.holds: `book` schedules the rehearsal, needing the player (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1897), so a jump stops at it.

promises.claim: A rehearsal kept moves the piece’s partner part when it’s held, and a request of theirs left open holds the piece’s other steps until you answer.
promises.holds: Kept, it moves the partner part (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1794); an ask left open refuses the piece's steps (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:607).

promises.claim: A rehearsal missed or called off late is held against you until you make amends, and two of them can bring a boundary.
promises.holds: A missed rehearsal or a late call-off is an incident to make right (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1763-1764, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:2039); two unrepaired bring a boundary (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:404).

promises.claim: The showing’s scene together shows their preparation, timing, agreement and reliability, separately from your band.
promises.holds: The partner as the scene together reads them: preparation, timing, agreement, reliability (`partnerReadOf`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:791-800), apart from the band (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1140-1145).

promises.claim: Each scene played together is counted, and Your Work So Far gives how they came out on average from the third on.
promises.holds: Each scene together is counted (`countTogether`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1144; src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:641); Playing With Others is named from the third (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:213).

promises.claim: A rehearsal booked on a day you’ve called in sick is excused, and costs none of their trust.
promises.holds: `rehearsalOutcome` excuses a rehearsal on a day called in sick, trust unmoved (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1751-1755).

promises.claim: A rehearsal kept rehearses the way you chose to play the scene, as a rehearsal step does.
promises.holds: `rehearsalOutcome` rehearses the chosen way in (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1799).

promises.claim: A classmate brings you something once you’ve met them, at Meeting Your Class or in class.
promises.holds: A classmate brings nothing before they're met (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:353); Meeting Your Class meets them (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1666), and the first class does before the day's moment is drawn (src/engine/systems/school.ts:3522-3524).

promises.claim: ${CHOICES.disagreement[1]!.label} replaces your answer to the question with theirs at once.
promises.holds: Try Theirs sets their answer at once (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:620).

promises.claim: An answer can change their trust, which counts when you ask them to rehearse; a boundary asks for a day’s notice.
promises.holds: An answer moves their trust (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:613, src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:622, src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:627), read when you ask (`askRefusal`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1732); a boundary asks a day's notice (`boundaryRefusal`, src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:295; src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1734).

promises.claim: An evening of running lines kept moves the lines of the scene you share ${pct(CLASS.study.memorization)} of what’s left.
promises.holds: An evening running lines kept moves the shared scene's lines `CLASS.study.memorization` of what's left (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:719).

promises.claim: A word after a hard showing lifts your morale ${CLASS.encourage.morale}.
promises.holds: A word after a hard showing lifts morale `CLASS.encourage.morale` (src/engine/systems/classmates.ts:431).

promises.claim: A scene’s lines learned to 30% let you try a way, and a problem in a part of the preparation is fixed by that part’s own step.
promises.holds: A scene can't be worked through under 30% of its lines (src/engine/systems/workpieces.ts:97); a `prep` problem has no adjustment (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:125-130, src/engine/content/workbook.ts:38-43), so the part's own step answers it.

promises.claim: The showing judges the scene with each part’s own work and every discovery you kept.
promises.holds: The showing judges the scene in its segments with each segment's own work and the ways kept (`scenePiece`'s `withBook`, src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:812-820).

promises.claim: A brief’s take includes its beats’ own work and the ways you kept, as its forecast did.
promises.holds: A take is judged on `briefPiece`, with its beats' work and the ways kept (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:315-322, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:633-637), as the forecast is (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:409).

promises.claim: ${ADJUSTMENTS['with-partner'].label} moves the preparation of a classmate reading a brief with you.
promises.holds: Run It With Your Partner moves a reading classmate's preparation (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:285).

promises.claim: A part’s director’s notes are worked on through Work On The Note, by the same ways; Work It Through takes what the notes leave.
promises.holds: A craft note's ways are the workbook's (`solutionsOf`, src/engine/systems/production.ts:438-443), tried through `tryAdjustment` (src/engine/systems/production.ts:653-668).

promises.claim: Play This Part Another Way works on an aspect the whole leaves open: leave one open to play a part its own way.
promises.holds: `waysFor` offers only axes the whole leaves open (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:162-169).

promises.claim: Working on an ability’s problem trains it a little, and running into a part trains adaptability.
promises.holds: A way at a limit or a segment held back by an ability trains it (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:299); Run Into It trains adaptability (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:300).

promises.claim: The profile opens with the guide’s chapter “${CHAPTER}”.
promises.holds: The profile chapter opens `ui.profile` (src/engine/content/tutorial.ts:444), which the shell reads (src/ui/shell/GameShell.tsx:51).

promises.claim: Each ability and technique has its exercise in the Practice column beside it.
promises.holds: Abilities and Techniques each have a Practice column (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:349, src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:396).

promises.claim: A piece of work in School Journey opens into how it was judged.
promises.holds: School Journey's work opens the work look (src/ui/looks/actor.tsx:245), which shows how it was judged.

promises.claim: Your Work So Far, near the profile’s foot, reads the actor your work shows.
promises.holds: Your Work So Far on the Profile (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:320) reads `identityOf` (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:85).

promises.claim: Readiness Today shows how ready you are for today’s work, from how you are.
promises.holds: Readiness Today (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:511) reads `readiness` (src/engine/systems/life.ts:284) at the hour.

promises.claim: P opens the profile from anywhere but a text box.
promises.holds: P opens /workspace/profile unless typing in a field or behind a dialog (src/app/game-context.tsx:439-445).

promises.claim: Practice is done from the Player Profile, in the row of what it trains.
promises.holds: Each row's Practice cell holds its exercise (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:349, src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:396), sending `practice.exercise`.

promises.claim: Each hour of practice moves the clock ${plural(PRACTICE.minutes, 'minute')} and spends its energy.
promises.holds: `practiceHour` moves the clock `PRACTICE.minutes` (src/engine/systems/practice.ts:184) and spends energy (src/engine/systems/practice.ts:187).

promises.claim: Every piece of work judged afterward is judged with your abilities and techniques where practice left them.
promises.holds: Practice grows the level where it's kept (src/engine/systems/practice.ts:188); every judgment reads the levels as they stand (`performerOf`, src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:107-111).

promises.claim: An exercise counts as experience of the material it names, and a brief built on that material prepares faster.
promises.holds: An hour counts toward the features its exercise practises (src/engine/systems/practice.ts:202); a brief's step reads them (`prepSpeed`, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:339, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:501; `featureSpeed`, src/engine/systems/experience.ts:140).

promises.claim: The material an exercise practices is kept in the record that Material You Know reads.
promises.holds: The features practised are kept (src/engine/systems/practice.ts:202), read by Material You Know (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:132-137; src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:324).

promises.claim: Stamina has no exercise: a workout under Look After Yourself builds it, and so does a class that trains the body as hard, attended.
promises.holds: No exercise trains stamina (`exerciseFor`, src/engine/content/practice.ts:131); a workout and a class that trains the body as hard build it (`classTrains`, src/engine/systems/life.ts:677; src/engine/systems/school.ts:3519).

promises.claim: A rested hour counts for more: the day’s focus scales every hour, and ${FOCUS.precision.label} most.
promises.holds: Every hour is scaled by the day's focus (`focusAt`, src/engine/systems/practice.ts:178, src/engine/systems/practice.ts:188), Precision most by it (`focusFactor`, src/engine/systems/practice.ts:95-96).

promises.claim: Genres is a panel of the Player Profile.
promises.holds: The Profile's Genres panel (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:451).

promises.claim: Knowing the genre is part of a take’s preparation: it counts toward the take’s interpretation, and is complete at ${pct(BRIEF.complete.genre)}.
promises.holds: Knowing the genre is a part of a take's preparation (`genreKnown`, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:333, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:400), read by interpretation (src/engine/content/tasks.ts `tape`), complete at `BRIEF.complete.genre` (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:294-297).

promises.claim: A scene from a play of a kind you know is prepared faster, by the better of Familiarity and Work In It.
promises.holds: A step is sped by the better of the scene's genres known, weighed as the scene asks (`requirementOfScene`: its own, else its play's, from brief 22, 2026-10-22), and the material's features (`genreSpeed`, src/engine/systems/engagement.ts:133; src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:682).

promises.claim: A part in a play of a kind you know is learned faster.
promises.holds: Learn The Part is sped by `genreSpeed` of the part's genres as its play or production states them (`requirementOfHolder`, from brief 22; src/engine/systems/production.ts:608), as a lines note worked is (src/engine/systems/production.ts:683).

promises.claim: Open Its Brief, beside each genre, opens the practice brief written for it.
promises.holds: Open Its Brief beside each genre (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:467).

promises.claim: The genres you’ve worked in are counted in Range.
promises.holds: Range counts the genres with practice (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:180-182).

promises.claim: A brief opens from its genre’s row in Genres, with Open Its Brief.
promises.holds: Open Its Brief on the genre's row (src/ui/workspaces/ProfileWorkspace.tsx:467).

promises.claim: The take judges each part of the preparation against what completes it, and rehearsal beat by beat.
promises.holds: Each part against `requiredOf` (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:294-297, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:400-403); rehearsal beat by beat in `briefPiece` (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:315-322).

promises.claim: ${BRIEF.steps.rehearse.label} rehearses the way you chose to play it, at ${pct(PLAYING.gainShare)} of the step’s reach.
promises.holds: Rehearse It rehearses the way in (`rehearseChoice`, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:503) at `PLAYING.gainShare` of the step's gain (src/engine/systems/material.ts:220-222).

promises.claim: A classmate reading with you learns it as you rehearse, at ${pct(BRIEF.reader.rehearse)} of the step’s reach.
promises.holds: A reading classmate learns it at `BRIEF.reader.rehearse` of the step (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:506).

promises.claim: ${BRIEF.steps.read.label} practices imagination and ${BRIEF.steps.lines.label} memory, a little each time the part rises.
promises.holds: Break It Down practises imagination and the lines memory when the part rises (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:511-512).

promises.claim: Work It Through works one beat at a time: Work It Slowly raises that beat’s own rehearsal.
promises.holds: Work It Slowly raises that beat's own work (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:272).

promises.claim: A new reading keeps ${pct(BRIEF.readingKept)} of the breakdown.
promises.holds: A changed reading keeps `BRIEF.readingKept` of the breakdown (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:526).

promises.claim: The take uses the reading and the way it’s played: what they lean toward, the abilities they call on, and how far the way is rehearsed.
promises.holds: `briefContext` leans by the reading and draws on its abilities (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:369-378), reads the way's material context and its rehearsal as preparation (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:366, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:402).

promises.claim: Each side newly chosen, and each take’s reading, is counted toward the habits Your Work So Far names.
promises.holds: A side newly chosen is noted (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:534); takes' readings are counted for a habit (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:161-170).

promises.claim: A scene for class is played the same three ways, chosen the same way.
promises.holds: `school.choose_playing` takes the same three axes (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:1946-1955) as `brief.choose` (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:837-843).

promises.claim: Play This Part Another Way plays one beat its own way, on an axis the whole leaves open.
promises.holds: `waysFor` (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:162-169), for a beat (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:198-205).

promises.claim: The take with its reader is what earns a callback; your own result counts nothing the reader brings.
promises.holds: A callback is earned by the take with its reader (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:684-685); the take's own result is `e.overall` (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:642, src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:666).

promises.claim: A take with a classmate at ${BAND_LABEL.strong} or better together adds about ${TOGETHER_BOND} to your bond; a slip of theirs you cover at least half of adds ${TOGETHER_COVERED} to their trust.
promises.holds: `afterTogether` moves the bond by `TOGETHER_BOND` at Strong or better and trust by `TOGETHER_COVERED` for a slip half covered (src/engine/systems/coursework.ts:142-151), from a take (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:662).

promises.claim: Run It With Your Partner brings a classmate reading with you ${pct(WORKBOOK.partnerGain)} of the way they have left.
promises.holds: Run It With Your Partner moves the reader `WORKBOOK.partnerGain` of what's left (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:285).

promises.claim: Every take with a reader counts toward Playing With Others, with the slips and those you covered.
promises.holds: Each take with a reader is counted together (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:663; src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:641), named Playing With Others from the third (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:209-213).

promises.claim: A take needs a reading chosen first.
promises.holds: `tapeRefusal` refuses a take before a reading (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:550).

promises.claim: Each take is kept on your work record, and opens there into how it was judged, beat by beat.
promises.holds: `tapeBrief` keeps the take on the record (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:642), which the work look opens beat by beat (src/ui/looks/actor.tsx:245).

promises.claim: A take is practice in the brief’s genres, one session’s worth shared among them.
promises.holds: `practiceGenres` shares one session among the brief's resolved genres by their weights (from brief 22, `requirementOfBrief`), by how far the take was prepared (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:656; src/engine/systems/engagement.ts:96-119).

promises.claim: A take grows ${TECHNIQUE_LABEL.screen}, or ${TECHNIQUE_LABEL.voiceover}, toward where classes level off.
promises.holds: A take grows screen or voice-over by `ordinary`, toward the reach classes level off at (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:648; src/engine/systems/school.ts:996).

promises.claim: Takes and their readings are read for habits, and a callback answered counts toward Taking Direction.
promises.holds: Takes' readings are read for habits (src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:161-170); a callback answered counts toward Taking Direction (src/engine/systems/briefs.ts:682; src/engine/systems/evaluation.ts:649; src/engine/systems/artistry.ts:184-193).

promises.claim: Work It Through names the problems the forecast shows before you tape: a beat not secure, a turn, stamina late.
promises.holds: `problemsOf` names a beat not secure, a turn and stamina late from the forecast (src/engine/systems/workbook.ts:89-115).

promises.claim: Rested, at readiness ${EVALUATION.sufficientReadiness} or more, tiredness costs a take nothing.
